complexityAnalysis.description: Measures the number of linearly independent paths through a program's source code, indicating its structural complexity. Higher values suggest more complex code with increased testing requirements. ([en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cyclomatic_complexity?utm_source=openai))

Calculates a program's size based on the number of assignments, branches, and conditionals, providing a scalar value that reflects code complexity. ([en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ABC_Software_Metric?utm_source=openai))

Assesses the efficiency of an algorithm by evaluating how its runtime increases with input size, typically expressed using Big O notation. ([algocademy.com](https://algocademy.com/blog/the-importance-of-time-complexity-analysis-in-software-development/?utm_source=openai))

Examines the interdependencies and relationships among components within a software system, where high interdependence can complicate maintenance and evolution. ([fastercapital.com](https://fastercapital.com/term/software-complexity.html?utm_source=openai))

Focuses on the challenges associated with deploying, running, and maintaining software in production environments, including infrastructure requirements and configuration management. ([fastercapital.com](https://fastercapital.com/term/software-complexity.html?utm_source=openai))
